en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a winding mountain road climbing in zigzags up a steep peak. At the top right, printed French text titles the scene as part of 'Le Cantal pittoresque', identifying the mountain as Le Puy Mary and the nearby pass Pas de Peyrol, as well as the road from Murat to Salers. At the bottom left, there is a boxed poetic caption in French about the road in long zigzags around the mountain.
